example_zh: 良好的散熱能延長設備壽命。

example_en: The data room has a gas-based fire suppression system.
example_zh: 資料機房配有氣體式消防滅火系統。

example_en: A humidity sensor warns us before water damages equipment.
example_zh: 濕度感測器會在水氣損害設備前發出警示。

example_en: A managed network frees small firms from daily maintenance.
example_zh: 託管網路服務讓小公司不必再做日常維護。

example_en: The bank links its branches through a private line.
example_zh: 這家銀行用專線連接各分行。

example_en: The data circuit was ordered for the new office.
example_zh: 新辦公室已申請了數據電路。

example_en: Bandwidth on demand lets you scale up for events.
example_zh: 頻寬隨選讓你在活動期間臨時加大頻寬。

example_en: We offer a cloud-based call center solution.
example_zh: 我們提供雲端式的客服中心方案。

example_en: Video conferencing needs stable upload speed.
example_zh: 視訊會議需要穩定的上傳速度。

example_en: The SMS campaign reached fifty thousand customers.
example_zh: 這場簡訊行銷活動觸及了五萬名客戶。

example_en: A voice broadcast reminded patients of their appointments.
example_zh: 語音群發提醒了病人回診時間。

example_en: SIP sets up and ends voice calls over IP.
example_zh: SIP 負責建立與結束網路語音通話。

example_en: Staff make calls from a softphone on their laptops.
example_zh: 員工用筆電上的軟體電話撥打電話。

example_en: The hunt group rings each agent in turn.
example_zh: 群組輪轉振鈴會依序呼叫每位客服。

example_en: Callers wait in the call queue for the next agent.
example_zh: 來電者在佇列中等候下一位客服。

example_en: Call monitoring helps supervisors coach new agents.
example_zh: 通話監聽可協助主管指導新進客服。

example_en: Call analytics reveal why customers phone us.
example_zh: 通話分析能看出客戶為什麼打電話來。

example_en: Each desk has an IP phone connected by Ethernet cable.
example_zh: 每張辦公桌都有一支以網路線連接的網路電話機。

example_en: Many offices are replacing the desk phone with apps.
example_zh: 許多辦公室正以 App 取代桌上型電話。

example_en: Dial the conference bridge number and enter the PIN.
example_zh: 撥打會議橋接號碼並輸入密碼。

example_en: The presence status shows who is available.
example_zh: 線上狀態會顯示誰目前方便接聽。

example_en: Market penetration of smartphones is above 90 percent.
example_zh: 智慧型手機的市場滲透率已超過百分之九十。

example_en: Subscriber growth slowed in the third quarter.
example_zh: 第三季的用戶成長趨緩。

example_en: Update the subscriber profile after the address change.
example_zh: 地址變更後，請更新用戶資料。

example_en: Young users are our fastest-growing market segment.
example_zh: 年輕用戶是我們成長最快的市場區隔。

example_en: Data revenue now exceeds voice revenue.
example_zh: 數據營收現在已超過語音營收。

example_en: Voice revenue has been declining for years.
example_zh: 語音營收已連續多年下滑。

example_en: The capex forecast includes new cell sites.
example_zh: 資本支出預估包含新建基地台。

example_en: Power bills dominate the opex forecast.
example_zh: 電費占了營運支出預估的大部分。

example_en: The royalty payment is due at the end of each quarter.
example_zh: 權利金在每一季末到期。

example_en: The rollout schedule covers three phases.
example_zh: 建置時程分為三個階段。

example_en: Mobile coverage in the mountains is still limited.
example_zh: 山區的行動網路涵蓋仍然有限。

example_en: The network upgrade will finish by December.
example_zh: 網路升級將在十二月前完成。

example_en: Please check whether your address is in our service area.
example_zh: 請確認你的地址是否在我們的服務區域內。

example_en: Line rental is billed separately from calls.
example_zh: 線路月租與通話費分開計費。

example_en: The call charge is based on duration.
example_zh: 通話費依通話時間計算。

example_en: Your connection speed depends on the time of day.
example_zh: 你的連線速度會隨時段而異。

example_en: A signal tower was built on the hill.
example_zh: 山丘上蓋了一座訊號塔。

example_en: The phone supports wireless charging.
example_zh: 這支手機支援無線充電。

example_en: Call transfer takes only a few seconds.
example_zh: 電話轉接只需要幾秒鐘。

example_en: Use the volume control if the caller sounds too quiet.
example_zh: 如果對方聲音太小，請用音量調整鍵。

example_en: You can dial the emergency number without a SIM card.
example_zh: 沒有 SIM 卡也能撥打緊急電話號碼。

example_en: Thick walls can cause signal interference indoors.
example_zh: 厚牆可能造成室內的訊號干擾。
